description: This is a Java unit test class that verifies the behavior of message annotation injection and extraction adapters within the Eclipse Hono tracing package. The test checks that entries injected into a message are correctly extracted after encoding and decoding.

classes.name: MessageAnnotationsInjectExtractAdapterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying injection and extraction of message annotations using adapters.

methods.name: testInjectAndExtract
methods.description: Test method that injects key-value pairs into a message, encodes and decodes it, then verifies the persistence and correctness of the injected annotations.
